topic: Øresund Bridge tunnel and Peberholm island
hook: Your drive from Denmark to Sweden goes underwater.
title: This Road Dives Under the Sea to an Island
description:
Driving from Denmark to Sweden over the Øresund link, the road starts in an undersea tunnel and surfaces on Peberholm, a completely man-made island. From there a bridge carries you into Sweden. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Oresund #Geography

scenes.headline: Bridge To Sweden

scenes.narration: Engineers went under to keep ships and planes clear.
